name: cc-stretch
description: Stretchtext replies for Claude Code: short by default, each phrase grows in place when you click it

marks.title: Closed stretch marks
marks.description: Marks on a phrase you can open, as a list of bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, dim. Empty keeps the underline; none takes every mark away. Under a highlight, dim is not drawn.

highlight.title: Closed stretch highlight
highlight.description: Background of a phrase you can open, as a hex colour such as #264f78, in any case. Its text turns near black or near white, whichever reads better. Empty for none.
